title: Unit – 2 : Session – 7 : SLO – 1 | Inheritance Basics
sections: In Java, inheritance allows a class to acquire properties and methods from another class using the keyword EXTENDS.
The class that inherits is called the SUBCLASS (child class).
The class being inherited from is called the SUPERCLASS (parent/base class).
Inheritance promotes code REUSE and reusability.
Java supports MULTIPLE inheritance through interfaces but not through classes.
